full_prompt_en: A square painterly portrait shows a dark-haired woman in warm yellow clothing against a rough ochre ground. The background is a broad, matte field of olive, tan, and muted turquoise, with scraped strokes and visible changes in paint thickness rather than any defined room. Her head and shoulders fill the center, and the top of her dark wavy bob approaches the upper edge. She faces the viewer in a slight three-quarter turn, chin lifted and lips gently parted, with a calm, direct expression. Thick side-swept hair crosses part of the left eye and curls outward at both sides of the jaw. The visible eyes are blue-green, set beneath dark brows and surrounded by softly brushed shadow. The nose, cheekbones, and mouth are built from small angular planes of peach, cream, rose, and warm brown, so the facial volume feels solid without a smooth photographic finish. A bright mustard-yellow garment gathers at the shoulders and along the right side of the neck, where a few deep navy strokes create a strong dark opening. The lower bust is cropped, allowing the lit face and yellow fabric to carry most of the frame. Broad, directional brush marks turn around the hair, while shorter broken dabs model skin and fabric. Thin flecks of turquoise near the head connect the face to the cooler notes in the ground. Light falls from the upper left and front, brightening the forehead, nose, cheek, and raised shoulder, with a deeper warm shadow under the chin and within the hair. The overall composition is close, confident, and warm, balancing recognizable facial detail with deliberately visible blocks of paint.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画肖像呈现一位深发女子穿暖黄色衣服，背后是粗糙赭色底。背景是橄榄、土黄与低调青绿色组成的宽阔哑光色域，有刮擦笔迹和可见的颜料厚薄变化，没有明确室内陈设。她的头肩填满中央，深色波浪短发顶部靠近上缘。她略以四分之三角度面对观者，下巴抬起，双唇微启，表情平静而直接。厚重侧分发丝遮住左眼一部分，并在下颌两侧向外卷起。可见的眼睛呈蓝绿色，位于深眉下，周围是柔刷的阴影。鼻梁、颧骨与嘴巴由桃、奶油、玫瑰与暖棕色小棱角平面搭建，使面部体积扎实，却没有平滑的摄影质感。明亮芥黄色衣服聚在肩头与颈部右侧，几道深海军蓝笔迹在那里形成强烈暗色开口。下胸部被裁去，使受光脸庞和黄衣承担画面大部。宽阔定向笔迹绕着头发转动，较短的断笔则塑造皮肤和布料。头旁少量青绿点色连接面部与背景较冷的音调。光从左上前方落下，提亮额头、鼻子、脸颊和抬起的肩部，下巴下与头发里保留更深暖影。整体构图贴近、自信而温暖，在可辨面部细节与有意显露的颜料块面之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The painterly portrait treatment models forms with short angular dabs and broad directional strokes rather than seamless gradients. Warm ochre, mustard, peach, and rose dominate, with dark navy and small turquoise notes cooling selected edges. Light and shadow are assigned in distinct patches, giving the focal form weight while keeping the brushwork conspicuous. Contours remain clearest near the most expressive details and loosen into broken, thickly painted marks at the periphery. A matte, scraped background supports the saturated focal accents without supplying narrative detail. Highlights arrive from an upper side and front direction, leaving compact shadow beneath projecting planes and deep pockets inside darker masses. The composition stays close and cropped, using visible paint blocks and a warm-cool balance to sustain immediacy. The overall effect is lively, intimate, and assured, with confident marks carrying both structure and emotion.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画肖像处理以短促棱角色点和宽阔定向笔触塑造形体，而非无缝渐层。暖赭、芥黄、桃色与玫瑰色占主导，深海军蓝和少量青绿重音冷却选定边缘。光影被分配进清楚斑块，让焦点形体有重量，同时让笔触显眼。轮廓在最富表情的细节附近最清晰，向外围松散成断续厚涂笔迹。哑光、刮擦的背景支撑饱和焦点重音，却不提供叙事细节。高光从上方一侧和正面进入，在突出的平面下方留下紧凑阴影，在较深体块内留浓暗处。构图贴近且裁切，依靠可见颜料块与冷暖平衡维持直接感。整体效果活泼、亲密而笃定，自信落笔同时承载结构与情绪。

name: John Larriva
